job.job_description:
We are looking for an Entry-Level Full Stack Developer to join our engineering team. This role is ideal for a recent graduate or early-career developer with hands-on exposure to building web applications through internships, hackathons, or academic/personal projects. Youll work across the stack building responsive user interfaces with React.js and robust backend services with Python (Flask/Django) while collaborating closely with senior engineers to ship real features.
Design and develop responsive, user-friendly frontend interfaces using React.js
Build and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services using Python (Flask or Django)
Integrate frontend applications with backend services and third-party APIs
Work with relational and/or NoSQL databases (MySQL / MongoDB) for data modeling and queries
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
Participate in code reviews, testing (including manual and API testing via tools like Postman), and debugging
Collaborate with designers, product managers, and other engineers to understand requirements and deliver features within timelines
Assist in identifying and fixing bugs, and improving application performance and usability
Required Skills
Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.js
Working knowledge of Python with experience in Flask or Django
Familiarity with REST API design and integration
Basic experience with MySQL and/or MongoDB
Understanding of version control tools (Git/GitHub)
Exposure to API testing tools such as Postman
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving ability
Good communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative team environment
Good to Have
Exposure to LLM models and AI integration.
Experience with web scraping or data extraction modules
Basic understanding of ML-assisted or rule-based analysis (e.g., security/fraud detection use cases)
Prior internship experience in a full-stack role
Participation in hackathons or coding competitions
A portfolio of personal or academic full-stack projects (GitHub links welcome)
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Strong academic record preferred
0-1 years of relevant experience through internships, projects, or hackathons
Location:
India - Maharashtra- Pune - Baner - Amar Madhuban Tech Park
Brand:
Sokrati
Time Type:
Full time
Contract Type:
Permanent
